meta.title: Buy YT: borrow PT → split → repay PT (one atomic transaction)

messages.label: Sell y PT for R POL
messages.note: These y PT are "borrowed": you hold none yet

messages.label: Put up y POL to split
messages.note: Your own funds + R → y PT + y YT

messages.label: Repay with the split's y PT
Receive y YT
messages.note: You actually pay y − R POL

cards.title: Payment and protection
items: A buy sets a maximum-pay cap; you can also set a price-protection limit with an expiry, and breaching it rolls back the whole transaction
Quotes are indicative only; within the protection limit the fill can still be worse (MEV / market moves)
No pre-deduction, no refund: the cap is a guardrail; only the actual cost is pulled

cards.title: Fees and fills
items: One underlying trade, one fee, charged on the full PT-leg size (amplified relative to the principal)
Fills depend on pool depth; no size is guaranteed to execute (clean failure)
Fee rules are exactly those of a normal PT/POL trade

cards.title: Preconditions and scope
items: Available only during the Locked phase
Receive y YT, actually pay y − R POL
